feat: complete O-RAN MANO deployment automation and project reorganization

## Deployment Infrastructure
- Add automated deployment system with tmux-based background execution
- Implement 8-stage deployment pipeline (environment, dependencies, images, cluster, components, tests, performance, reporting)
- Add deployment scripts and Kind cluster configuration
- Create deployment guide with monitoring instructions

## CI/CD Enhancements
- Add 4 new GitHub Actions workflows:
  * deployment-automation.yml: Automated deployment pipeline
  * enhanced-ci-v2.yml: Improved CI with parallel testing
  * monitoring-alerting.yml: Health monitoring and alerts
  * performance-testing.yml: Performance validation

## Enhanced Components
- Implement O2IMS/O2DMS enhanced clients with filtering support
- Add state machine for orchestrator workflow management
- Implement QoS manager for TN bandwidth control
- Add enhanced backend integration tests

## Web Dashboard
- Complete React + TypeScript dashboard implementation
- Add real-time monitoring with WebSocket support
- Implement intent, slice, and experiment management pages
- Include Prometheus metrics integration
- Add Docker deployment with Kubernetes manifests

## Documentation & Organization
- Reorganize project structure: move all reports to docs/
- Add comprehensive API documentation with OpenAPI spec
- Create CI/CD configuration and runbooks
- Add deployment guide and next steps documentation
- Organize analysis, architecture, and research docs

## Code Quality
- Update coverage reports
- Clean up root directory (move all working files to docs/)
- Add comprehensive test results and reports
- Update CLAUDE.md with SPARC development workflow

This commit implements the deployment system described in docs/DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE_AND_NEXT_STEPS.md
and ensures project cleanliness with proper file organization.
